name: Giada, Font of Hope
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Each other Angel you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each Angel you already control.
{T}: Add {W}. Spend this mana only to cast an Angel spell.
blocked_sentences: Each other Angel you control enters with an additional +1/+1 counter on it for each Angel you already control.

needs.what: the enters_with_additional_counters static with a computed amount: a static_value_keys `count` evaluated as the permanent enters, over a selector (controller you, subtypes Angel) that excludes the arriving permanent itself ("Angels you ALREADY control"), e.g. amount {"count": {"controller": "you", "subtypes": ["Angel"]}} with the entrant excluded
needs.why_existing_wont_do: enters_with_additional_counters exists (Oath of Gideon) but _apply_board_additional_counters in src/automtg/engine/zones.py reads `int(static.get("amount", 1))` -- a fixed integer only, so a value spec cannot be given. It also runs after the entrant is already in state.battlefield, so a naive count would include the arriving Angel. A permanent_enters trigger with add_counters would be a triggered ability rather than a replacement (counters arrive late, the creature enters as its base size, and it is respondable), which is an approximation the brief forbids. replace_counters only modifies counter placements, not the entering itself.
